alerts.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 24 at 9:50AM PST until November 24 at 12:00PM PST by NWS Hanford CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Areas of visibility one quarter mile or less in dense fog
continues to present a high risk for transportation.

* WHERE...The San Joaquin Valley.

* WHEN...Until noon PST today.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Highways affected include Interstate 5 and
state highways 99, 65, 198, 41, 43, 46, 190, 180, 168, 152.
alerts.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.
